# Optional — only for scripts/fetch_dataset_samples.py (real Mind2Web / ALFRED / SWE-bench_Verified

# these. Mind2Web and SWE-bench_Verified are sampled via duckdb's httpfs extension querying
# Hugging Face's auto-generated Parquet conversion, projecting only the lightweight text columns —

# Mind2Web's non-JSONL, HTML-embedded format) and not huggingface_hub (no single-file download
# needed at all).
